SENECA ROCKS'''''
''This inaccessible fin-like peak, also known colloquially as 'razorback ridge,' is a massive mountain of quartzite and cannot be climbed. However, there is a path south of the Visitor Center that cuts up and east toward the railroad and Interstate 63."''
([[Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide Atlas of Appalachia]]) at the north end of the River Knobs. The Rocks were used as a training ground by the 10th Mountain division of the Army during 1943 and 1944, preparing for combat in the Apennines of Italy.{{citation needed}} ==Layout== Seneca Rocks is a large crag consisting of sheer rock faces, steep cliffs, and jagged terrain. The prominent geological formation rises high above the landscape, comprised of a northern and southern peak with a central notch overlooking Route 68. As of [[Timeline#2103|2103]], the body of a [[Vulture (Fallout 76)|vulture]] is impaled on the eastern cliff face. A hiking trail starts at the [[Seneca Rocks Visitor Center]] and forks along the various plateaus along the western side of the location, including one footpath leading to the [[Fort Atlas|ATLAS Observatory]]. Similarly, a narrow dirt path leads north from [[Pleasant Valley cabins]] into the Seneca Rock's southwestern cliffs and forks around to the eastern side of the rock formation. It also branches into a hidden path marked with a blood-soaked rock that leads to the corpses of [[Olivia Rivers|Olivia]] and [[Shannon Rivers]]. While the peaks are largely inaccessible, the northern peak can be accessed from the northern side of the Rocks, albeit with difficulty given the jagged, uneven terrain. The southern peak can only be accessed by leaping from the northern peak across the central notch. At the top of the southern peak, an [[Imported Chinese panda]] and [[Jangles the Moon Monkey (Fallout 76)|Jangles the Moon Monkey]] can be found in a bush, with ''"astropanda rowan seneca"'' {{sic}} written in chalk upon a rock. ==Notable loot== * [[Headmistress Shannon Rivers' login]] - On the corpse of [[Shannon Rivers]], accesses [[Cryptos]] terminal at [[Riverside Manor]]. * [[Eye of Ra]] - Brooch, on the corpse of Shannon Rivers. * [[Shannon Rivers' recording]] - Holotape, on the corpse of Shannon Rivers. ==Appearances== Seneca Rocks appears only {{In|FO76}}. ==Behind the scenes== Seneca Rocks is based on the real world location of [[Wikipedia:Seneca Rocks|Seneca Rocks]] in [[Wikipedia:West Virginia|West Virginia]], which has an altitude of 1,568 feet (478 meters). ==Gallery== FO76 Seneca Rocks.png|Seneca Rocks western face, pre-''Wastelanders''. Note the increased number of trees along the ridge F76 Seneca Rocks.png|Seneca Rocks eastern face, pre-''Wastelanders'' FO76WL Seneca Rocks eastern face.png|Eastern face as of ''Wastelanders'', with the vulture corpse present FO76WL Vulture corpse.png|The impaled [[Vulture (Fallout 76)|vulture]] added in ''Wastelanders'' FO76WL Seneca Rocks panda.png|Panda bear at southern peak as of ''Wastelanders'' FO76WL Seneca Rocks panda 2.png| Fallout Magic Mountain full art Isometric.png|[[Magic: The Gathering]] ==References== {{References}} '''Non-game''' {{References|group=Non-game}} {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:Fallout 76 locations]] [[Category:Savage Divide locations]] [[ru:Сенека-Рокс]] [[uk:Сенека-Рокс]] [[zh:塞內卡巖石]]
